title: Open a built project's Home chat again and go on with it
request: When I come to a project in Home I cannot see the previous chat; maybe I want to continue and add something to the chat. Fix it.
spec: The project keeps its draft (project.draft.id) and the draft keeps its messages after the build; the server takes new messages on it.
plan: Find why Home hides the chat
Reopen a built draft's chat from the projects list and on return
Say in the chat that the project changes only when built again

decisions.decision: The fix is in the page only: the server already keeps the chat and takes new messages.
decisions.why: The smallest change, and the owner's running server was not restarted again.

decisions.decision: A message added after the build stays on the chat; the project changes when built again or on its own pages.
decisions.why: A chat must not change a project's solution behind its validator.

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/home.html: resume and ensureDraft take a built draft; an Open its chat link on each project row; the chat's subtitle for a built project.

findings.defect: A built project's chat could not be seen or continued on Home.
findings.scenario: The person built a project from the Home chat, came back to Home and found no conversation to read or add to.
findings.cause: Home reopened only drafts whose status was open and forgot a built one; no project row linked to its draft.
findings.fix: Home reopens open and built drafts; each project row has Open its chat, which reads the project's draft id.
findings.test: browser check on the owner's project: the chat opened with its 16 messages and the reply box enabled

measurements.name: The owner's project in the browser
measurements.gate: the project's chat opens with its messages and takes a reply
measurements.result: 16 messages shown, the reply box enabled, the subtitle says the chat is the project's

outcome: A person can read a project's Home chat again and go on with it.
lessons: A state filter on the page (only open drafts) can hide data the server keeps whole.
risks: What is settled in the chat after the build does not change the project until it is built again.
